comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber vs assemble and support a shock-corded antenna mast.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool insertion, collar tuning and torque-limited locking vs aligning multiple spigots, overcoming shock-cord preload and seating joints.
comparison.success_condition: Repeatable non-bottoming impacts with no setting drift vs both mast joints within gap/bend tolerances and the released mast resting on two stands.
comparison.reason: The word “shock” is incidental; mast assembly tests compliant multi-part insertion, not damping adjustment. Missing rubric detail: no material novelty-relevant gap.
